name: Kannapolis Parks & Recreation

parks.name: Bakers Creek Park
parks.about: Kannapolis's main active park: a large playground, four lighted tennis courts (free in daylight), volleyball, horseshoes, a half basketball court, a lighted softball field, sports equipment to rent ($1/hour with photo ID), greenway access, restrooms and a cash-only snack bar (mid-March to late October).

parks.name: Village Park
parks.about: Home of the summer concert and movie series in the county's largest amphitheater, plus the carousel, the Rotary Express train and a splash pad ($2 per ride or entry), picnic shelters and the Park Building for parties and receptions.

parks.name: Safrit Park
parks.about: A playground, a picnic shelter, two lighted softball fields, a lighted soccer field and a half-mile paved walking trail. Restrooms and concessions open during park events.

parks.name: Vietnam Veterans Park
parks.about: Operated by Cabarrus County: playgrounds, four picnic shelters, two basketball courts, volleyball, bench swings, horseshoes, a 9-hole disc golf course, bocce, a boardwalk, a 1.2-mile walking trail and a wetlands trail. Parking for the Irish Buffalo Creek Greenway.

parks.name: Veterans Park
parks.about: A downtown memorial with an eternal flame, fountains and the granite Ring of Honor listing more than 1,700 people from Rowan and Cabarrus counties who died in service. Engraved bricks can be ordered.

parks.name: Dale Earnhardt Plaza
parks.about: A one-acre plaza on Main Street with a 9-foot bronze statue of hometown racing legend Dale Earnhardt, gardens and fan bricks. It can be reserved for events and weddings.

parks.name: Atrium Health Ballpark
parks.hours: Sunrise to sunset on non-game days
parks.about: Home of the Cannon Ballers, and a city park on non-game days: a 20,000 sq ft children's play area with a three-story play structure, and a walking track around the concourse. Its splash pad has been closed since May 15, 2026 because of drought restrictions.

parks.name: West Avenue Park
parks.address: Downtown: West Avenue, Main Street, Oak Avenue, Vance Street
parks.about: The downtown park around West Avenue: public restrooms, fountains, entertainment stages, a putting green, urban swings and outdoor dining.

parks.name: Kannapolis Middle School fields
parks.about: Shared with Kannapolis City Schools: lighted softball, baseball and soccer/football fields, and a regulation 400m track open for walking and running.

parks.name: Lentz Park
parks.about: A baseball diamond and a multipurpose field with restrooms and concessions, named for teacher and youth umpire Barry Lentz.

seasons.note: Weekends in spring and fall, daily from Memorial Day to early August

seasons.label: Celebration of Lights
seasons.note: Nightly during the Celebration of Lights: the Winterland Express train and the carousel
Daily in summer, weekends through Labor Day

greenways.name: Bakers Creek & 8th Street Greenways
greenways.route: Bakers Creek Park → West A Street → 8th Street → Loop Road → Village Park
greenways.parking: Village Park and the YMCA (open any time); Bakers Creek Park (gated, park hours only: cars can get locked in)

greenways.name: Irish Buffalo Creek Greenway
greenways.route: Orphanage Road to Rogers Lake Road, with three pedestrian bridges; part of the Carolina Thread Trail
greenways.parking: Vietnam Veterans Park only. Walk-on access at Oakwood Avenue and Rogers Lake Road

programs.title: Sign up for sports & programs
programs.text: Youth soccer, baseball/softball, basketball and flag football; classes and camps. Register online or at the office.

programs.title: Help paying for youth sports
programs.text: Youth sports usually cost $50 for residents ($75 non-residents). Scholarships are available.

programs.title: Game cancelled for weather?
programs.text: Call the inclement weather hotline after 4 p.m. on weekdays or after 8 a.m. on Saturdays: 704-920-4344.

programs.title: Coach a youth team
programs.text: Volunteer coaches must be 18+, apply, and pass a background check.

programs.title: Tennis & pickleball clinics
programs.text: Eight-week clinics for youth and adults at Bakers Creek Park.

programs.title: Run Kannapolis 5K series
programs.text: Eight community 5K runs/walks a year, most with a one-mile fun run.

rent.title: Picnic shelters
rent.text: Half-day reservations online; full-day by phone (704-920-4343) or email.

rent.title: Village Park Building
rent.text: Seats about 100 (75 at tables): receptions, reunions, showers, meetings.

rent.title: Athletic fields
rent.text: Rent a field for games or practice by phone or email.

rent.title: Host a special event
rent.text: Planning an event in a park or downtown?

involved.title: Order a Dale Earnhardt Plaza brick
Be an event vendor or suggest a band

rules: No alcohol in parks (the Village Park Building allows it by permit).
Pets are welcome on a leash of 6 feet or less; please clean up after them. No pets at concerts or movies.
Under 18 at movies in the park must be with a parent or guardian.
accreditation: Nationally accredited by CAPRA (Commission for Accreditation of Park and Recreation Agencies)

holiday.title: A Kannapolis Christmas
holiday.summary: Thousands of lights, the Winterland Express train and the carousel, free photos with Santa, holiday crafts, s'mores by the fire pit, weekend artisans and food trucks.
holiday.free: Admission, the light displays and parking are free. Train and carousel rides need tickets ($2.50).

tickets.label: Reserve train seats
tickets.note: Online reservations are for Sunday–Thursday. Friday, Saturday and the week before Christmas: buy tickets on site the day of. Walk-up tickets are sold nightly at the carousel or park building.

holiday.weather: May close for bad weather: call 704-920-4344 for updates.

events.title: Last day to order a Letter from Santa
events.note: $3, mailed Dec 7–11 with a North Pole postmark

train.name: Winterland Express
train.about: The Christmastime train at Village Park runs every 10 minutes each evening during the Celebration of Lights.
train.price: $2.50 per ride (carousel too; no reservation needed for the carousel)
train.how: Reserve online, then go straight to the train station with your mobile or printed ticket.
train.walkup: Fridays, Saturdays and the week before Christmas are first come, first served. Walk-up tickets are sold nightly at the carousel or park building, including Sunday–Thursday when reserved seats run out.
train.rainout: If weather keeps the park closed, your ticket is honored on another night of your choice (as seats allow). Rainout hotline: 704-920-4344.
